gbm_population_evidence.quote: Tumor suspected as glioma (1. Astrocytoma, IDH mutant 2. Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted 3. Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype)
Brain Neoplasm; Brain Metastases; Glioma; Meningioma

coder_notes: Device/procedure trial (cryoablation); no drug registered. Population is mixed brain tumours (glioma types, meningioma, brain metastases); glioblastoma IDH-wildtype is named only in the inclusion criteria. Coded basket_gbm_eligible because metastases and meningioma are eligible besides gliomas; mixed_glioma_gbm_named is the alternative. Does not affect screening outcome. IDH types in the criteria describe tumour types, not an IDH entry requirement.
